name: local-mods
description: Claude Code terminal UI mods: a status band above the prompt and side panes for token usage and git changes

plugins.name: token-usage
plugins.description: A pane showing context fill, session token totals, cost and rate limits

plugins.name: prompt-status
plugins.description: Two-line status above the prompt: model, directory, git branch, context fill and rate-limit usage

plugins.name: git-changes
plugins.description: A side pane listing the files changed in the working tree, with colored git diff stats
